splash.webglTitle: 3D graphics (WebGL) are switched off in the browser right now
splash.webglText: {name} needs WebGL to draw the 3D view. The browser reports that it cannot create a WebGL context – usually because the graphics card was blocked for this session after a driver crash.
splash.webglRestart: Close the browser completely and start it again
splash.webglRestartHint: (all windows) – that almost always solves it.
splash.webglStatus: Check the status at {chrome} or {edge} – it should say “WebGL: Hardware accelerated”.
splash.webglDrivers: Update the graphics driver; with many open 3D tabs close some of them.
splash.failedText: An error occurred while starting. Details are in the browser console (F12).
